notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40257777/62eefb10bc8d6aa3f198dd2b3a753db750bbe9aa.gif[/img]
Sokocat gets its first update with major game changes. After analyzing the entire project, I see that it was not graphically attractive and that it needed a change, so I dedicated myself to learning about shaders and managed to create a more beautiful water, giving a new look to the game.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ft9xuQw.gif[/img]

little comparison:
[b]old[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40257777/04a3e54070ba03b3cb8e6485149d96a8206ca773.png[/img]
[b]new[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40257777/46f55656f76ca251e20ee982437894e5be501771.png[/img]

The game camera is now a little closer to the player, on small islands it remains fixed and with full view of the island, but on larger islands it will follow the player, but don't worry, you can still see much of the island . I think this makes the game more dynamic and has a sense of exploration.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/35dAAX7.gif[/img]

At the request of players, you can now resize the game window manually, just disable the full-screen option and take the mouse outside the window and resize it to your liking.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1592880/Sokocat__Islands/

List of changes:
- Graphic improvement.
- Camera follows the player on large islands.
- Improved gameplay.
- It is now possible to resize the game window.

Thank you for your support! Your feedback about the game is very important!

Regards,
Alysson N. Moraes - Developer.

notes.title: Sokocat: Island - Update 1.0.5 (Help button)
notes.notes:
After looking at the game's stats and reading some player reports, we noticed that some players got stuck on some islands in the game. island 19 for example.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/LkEs2L6.gif[/img]

To help in these phases, we created the "ghost cat" that will help showing the path that the player must follow to solve the puzzles. It will repeat the same path I taught playing the game, you just need to follow it.

to activate it just press the button indicated in the upper right corner of the screen, press "Y" for Xbox controllers for example, or "H" if using the keyboard. To deactivate it, just press again.

[b]It's important to remember that the ghost cat will take into account the initial position of the boxes, so I activated it right at the beginning of the phase to ensure that the boxes weren't moved.[/b]

Hope this helps you get solve the most difficult puzzles and that you can enjoy the game in the best way possible. Have a good time!

Att,
Alysson N. Moraes - Developer.
